name: Nun
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: His servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle. Joshua was a true disciple, a learner, eager to stay by Moses' side and learn; the Lord knew his spirit.

note.label: Exodus 33: My Presence Shall Go with Thee

points: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes.

The tenth provocation was the report of the spies, and it was the last: how long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh and Joshua the son of Nun, because Caleb had another spirit with him and followed the Lord fully.

note.label: 70 Times 7: The Perfection of Mercy Through Christ

points: Among these numbered by Moses and Eleazar in the plains of Moab there was not a man of them that was numbered in the wilderness of Sinai, for the Lord had said of them, they shall surely die in the wilderness; and there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh and Joshua the son of Nun.

note.label: Numbers 26: The Second Census of the Families of Israel

points: And the Lord said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him. So Joshua also had the spirit, the Holy Spirit, upon him.
The Lord answered: take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him.

note.label: Numbers 27: The Daughters of Zelophehad and the Ordination of Joshua

points: The Lord named the men which shall divide the land: Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun, and one prince of every tribe, Caleb the son of Jephunneh for Judah and the rest by name.

note.label: Numbers 34: The Borders of the Land of Canaan

points: Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him. Joshua was Moses' protege, and he carried the spirit Moses had, a great leader compassionate for the people; and the children of Israel hearkened unto him, and did as the Lord commanded Moses.

And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot's house, named Rahab, and lodged there. Because they were going to take the land.

So the two men returned, and descended from the mountain, and passed over, and came to Joshua the son of Nun, and told him all things that befell them: and they said unto Joshua, Truly the Lord hath delivered into our hands all the land. This is going to be easy, to kill everybody. For even all the inhabitants of the country do faint because of us. That woman told them the reason why you are going to win is because everybody is afraid. And then she kept it a secret. She said, I am not going to tell them.

The countries in the land of Canaan were distributed by Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes, by lot, as the Most High commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes and the half tribe; Moses had already given the two tribes and a half their inheritance on the other side Jordan.

note.label: Joshua 14: Caleb Wholly Followed the Most High

points: They came near before Eleazar the priest, before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying the Lord commanded Moses to give them an inheritance among their brethren; and according to the commandment of the Lord he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.

note.label: Joshua 17: The Lot of Manasseh and the Blessing of Ephraim

points: Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes divided the inheritances by lot in Shiloh before the Lord, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. So they made an end of dividing the country; everybody had their portion, and everyone was satisfied.

note.label: Joshua 19: The Portions of the Remaining Tribes

points: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the Lord, died an hundred and ten years old and was buried in the border of his own inheritance in Timnath-serah, in mount Ephraim.

note.label: Book of Our Fathers: Who’s Who Part 3

points: After these things Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being an hundred and ten years old.

note.label: Joshua 24: Choose You This Day Whom Ye Will Serve

points: Joshua the son of Nun dies at a hundred and ten years old and is buried in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-heres, in the mount of Ephraim, because Joshua was of the tribe of Ephraim; he was buried in the land of his own tribe's inheritance.

note.label: Judges 2: No League with the Inhabitants of the Land
